name: Den-En-Chofu
tagline: Shibuya in 17 minutes and Shinagawa in 25 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, where Tokyu run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 39 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 17 minutes to Shibuya and 25 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 30.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 18.3 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 30.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 21.9 m to 40.2 m, a difference of 18.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

groceries.name: 東急ストア 田園調布店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 3 clinics. The nearest hospital is おくさわ脳卒中リハビリテーション病院, about 15 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 奥沢病院, about 17 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Tokyu Toyoko Line and Tokyu Meguro Line. Both lines are run by Tokyu, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Tokyu Meguro Line runs at 133% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 不動前→目黒, which this station is not on. Tokyu Toyoko Line runs at 124%. Its busiest stretch is 祐天寺→中目黒, which this station is likewise not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. For 1K, 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Tamagawa is ahead on the number of lines, but Den-En-Chofu is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Den-En-Chofu. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Den-En-Chofu.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Den-En-Chofu, but Okusawa is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Den-En-Chofu. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Den-En-Chofu. One-room rents run about ¥13,000 higher.

goodFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: The nearest big road, 環八通り, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Neither the station nor the ground around it falls inside the projected flood area.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
